speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of cognitive decline, psychiatric symptoms, and white matter lesions, I need to rule out infectious causes like PML or HIV. Do you have any history of HIV, organ transplantation, or other conditions causing significant immunosuppression? REQUEST TEST: HIV_Viral_Load

speaker: Doctor
text: The high viral load confirms HIV infection, which strongly suggests Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) given the nonenhancing white matter lesions. I need to confirm the presence of the JC virus in the cerebrospinal fluid to finalize the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: CSF_JC_Virus_PCR

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative JC virus PCR makes PML unlikely despite the HIV status and white matter lesions. I need to rule out other opportunistic infections or inflammatory processes. REQUEST TEST: CSF_Viral_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: With HIV, nonenhancing white matter lesions, and negative infectious workup, HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder or HIV encephalitis remains the most likely diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: HIV Encephalitis
